meta.title: Apply for the Scholarship
meta.description: The seven-step application wizard — student, guardian, academic, and payment details, with an autosaved draft.

eligibility.heading: Confirm your eligibility
eligibility.intro: Four quick confirmations before we collect any details.

enrolled.label: The student is enrolled in the grade applied for, in the 2026 academic year
enrolled.description: You will select the grade in Step 4.

recognized.label: The institution is recognized by the relevant education board or authority
recognized.description: Government, private, and madrasa boards all count.

singleApplication.label: This is the only application for this student in the 2026 cycle
singleApplication.description: Duplicate submissions are rejected by the system.

accurateInfo.label: All information I provide will be accurate and complete
accurateInfo.description: Inaccurate applications can be cancelled during review.

student.heading: Student information
student.fullNameHint: Exactly as printed on the birth certificate.

guardian.heading: Guardian information
guardian.intro: We contact the guardian about exam-day arrangements and results.

payment.heading: Payment reference
payment.intro: Send the application fee through DemoPay (fictional mobile financial service), then enter the transaction ID below. Verification is simulated — no real money moves anywhere.
payment.transactionIdHint: 8–20 letters or digits, e.g. DEMO8F3K2Q. For testing: IDs ending in 00 simulate a flagged payment.
payment.selectGradeFirst: Select a grade in Step 4 to see the fee.

review.heading: Review your application
review.intro: Check every section carefully — you can still go back and edit.
review.submitNote: By submitting you confirm the information above is accurate. You will receive an application ID to track your application.

success.heading: Application submitted
success.saveIdNote: Save this ID — you need it to track your application and download your admit card.

next.heading: What happens next
next.review: The program office reviews the application.
next.results: Results publish on 31 January 2027 — track your application anytime.

validation.phoneInvalid: Enter a valid 11-digit mobile number starting with 01.
validation.ageOutOfRange: The student must be between 7 and 20 years old.
validation.mustAccept: You must confirm this to continue.
validation.duplicateTransaction: This transaction ID was already used in this cycle.
